verified_exact_locator_families.support: Study conducted 2009-2012 in Ranchi and Khunti; four tribal hamlets in each district initially visited; interviews in eight villages with 40 people, followed by eight more villages for authentication; specimens collected with informants from gardens, cultivated land, forests and markets.

Authors report 41 leafy indigenous vegetables used by the Munda tribe in Khunti and Ranchi districts; Table 1 supplies scientific name, Mundari name, habit, habitat, parts consumed, availability and sale fields.
Study-area map for traditional leafy vegetables used by the Munda tribe in Ranchi and Khunti districts.
